we developed an approach to extracting information about a domain of interest from unstructured documents, and that our approach attained high accuracy in experiments on two different types applications.

developing a new approach to the extraction of information from data rich unstructured documents based solely on an application ontology.
developing a general approach for extracting structured information from unstructured text, which is based on an application-specific ontology.
the problem of how to extract and organize information from unstructured data sources in a way that facilitates their integration into a structured database.

our approach is capable of automatically extracting structured information from unstructured data-rich Web documents.
